subject.title: Field Report: 25 findings from 4 weeks of self-hosted production use (config crashes, CLI docs, Discord, cron)

question: Should maintainers keep this broad field report open as a routing umbrella, or split/link the remaining slices to narrower canonical issues and retire the umbrella?
rationale: Current main only proves partial fixes, and the unresolved behavior spans gateway config availability, Discord delivery, cron/tooling, setup auth, updates, and resource policy; choosing whether the umbrella remains useful is a maintainer workflow and product-scope decision.

options.title: Split and retire umbrella
options.body: Link the strongest remaining slices to canonical owner-scoped issues such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/85695 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/55792, open any missing focused follow-ups, then close this umbrella.

options.title: Keep umbrella open
options.body: Leave this issue open as the broad field-report tracker until every slice is fixed, rejected, or explicitly moved, accepting that it remains hard to validate automatically.

options.title: Close as partially superseded
options.body: Close this issue now with links to the existing narrower follow-ups, accepting that weaker slices should be re-filed if they recur with current-main proof.

recommendation.title: Split and retire umbrella
recommendation.body: Link the strongest remaining slices to canonical owner-scoped issues such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/85695 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/55792, open any missing focused follow-ups, then close this umbrella.

likelyOwner.reason: The broad decision crosses cron, Discord, gateway docs, and onboarding surfaces where this handle appears repeatedly in recent history.
